source_note: Thresholds and calendar from a structured interview with an Extension Planning Area field officer, Mulanje, October 2026. Zone boundaries are approximate and serve the prototype only.

lowland.label: Lowland
lowland.description: Lower-lying sections away from the massif. Rainfall more evenly distributed; onset generally earlier and more reliable than upland.

onset_rule.note: At least 20 mm of continuous moisture over 2-3 days.

lowland.confirmation: Soil holds moisture at wrist depth. Not verifiable from rainfall data alone; stated as a field check in the advisory.

upland.label: Upland (near the massif)
upland.description: Sections near Mulanje mountain. Subject to chiperoni drizzle and localised orographic showers that wet topsoil without producing root-depth moisture. Onset threshold set higher for this reason.

onset_rule.note: At least 30 mm over 2-3 days. The higher bar guards against false starts from chiperoni showers.

upland.confirmation: Soil holds moisture at wrist depth. Critical in this zone: topsoil wetting from drizzle is common and misleading.

varieties.name: early maturing
varieties.note: Preferred where onset is late or a dry spell is likely.

beans.planting_window: intercropped, or relay after first weeding

rejection_triggers: Blanket advice issued across both zones without stating the rainfall threshold applied.
Any recommendation naming a seed variety or chemical not stocked locally or under AIP.
Advice that contradicts observed local conditions without acknowledging the discrepancy.
